sections.title: 30-second answer
sections.callout: Use Sire of Shards when radial projectile coverage is the build's engine; replace it when a directional spell or rare staff gives more useful damage and defenses.
calloutDetail: The staff forces projectile spells to fire in a circle and adds four projectiles. That changes how a skill reaches a target, so it can be an enabler or a liability rather than a simple damage upgrade.

sections.title: How the item works
paragraphs: Projectile spells fire four additional projectiles and distribute them around the caster. Extra projectiles improve area coverage, but a radial pattern can send fewer projectiles toward a single distant target than a directional cast.
The modifier belongs to spells. Attacks and non-projectile spells do not gain the signature benefit. Confirm the skill tags and observe the actual launch pattern before building around it.
Sigil of Power is a separate granted skill from the Chiming Staff base. Its value depends on whether the build can stand in or reuse the area without compromising movement.

steps.label: Check the skill
body: Confirm it is a projectile spell and that a circular pattern creates useful coverage.

steps.label: Test single target
body: Cast at a lone target from realistic range and count how many projectiles can connect.

steps.label: Plan defenses
body: Replace the life, block, Energy Shield, or resistances that a shield or rare off-hand would have supplied.

steps.label: Use Sigil deliberately
body: Place it for a boss or stationary mechanic; do not interrupt every pack to cast it.

steps.label: Set a replacement rule
body: Move to a rare staff or one-hand setup when the radial pattern no longer compensates for lost affixes.

sections.title: Build use cases
intro: These are mechanical use cases, not a promise that the unique is best in slot.

builds.title: Close-range projectile nova
builds.description: Uses the circular launch pattern to cover enemies around the character.

builds.title: Triggered projectile package
builds.description: Can value extra projectile coverage if the trigger position is predictable.

builds.title: Budget spell levelling
builds.description: Uses spell damage and cast speed until a rare weapon package becomes stronger.

sections.title: Alternatives and replacement point
paragraphs: A rare staff can offer stronger spell levels or focused damage without forcing a circular pattern.
A wand plus shield gives up the extra projectiles but can add defenses, mana, and more flexible affixes.
For a skill that already covers the screen, replace Sire of Shards when the next upgrade improves boss damage or survival more than four extra radial projectiles.

problems.symptom: Only one projectile seems to hit a boss
checks: Confirm the skill can overlap projectiles.
Use a separate single-target skill if overlap is not possible.
Add life and resistances on armour and jewellery.
Do not count the staff's small all-resistance roll as a full defensive layer.

problems.symptom: An attack skill does not gain projectiles
checks: Use a spell or choose a different weapon.

items.question: Does it work with attacks?
answer: Its signature line specifies spells, so attack projectiles are not the intended beneficiary.

items.question: Do all projectiles hit one boss?
answer: Not automatically. The circular pattern and the skill's collision rules determine overlap.

items.question: Is it an endgame weapon?
answer: It can be for a build enabled by the pattern, but many casters eventually prefer stronger rare affixes or a shield.

items.question: Why is cast speed important?
answer: It improves self-cast responsiveness and is one of the staff's conventional variable rolls.

items.question: What is the biggest hidden cost?
answer: Occupying both hands while forcing a projectile pattern that may not suit single-target encounters.
